answer: Reputation escrow with slashing makes a Sybil swarm pay per fake face. An agent posts a 500 POA bond to trade, and each verified deal adds reputation. Step one, the bond locks on chain. Step two, peers rate each deal and update the score. Step three, a fraud proof slashes the bond and restarts the agent at zero. Faking a thousand agents costs 500,000 POA plus weeks rebuilding. A hollow shell game collapses at the first audit. Honest agents climb to the summit together while attackers drown in the inlet of their own sunk costs, like a counterfeiter buying a press to forge pennies.
